facts.fact: This document is the text of Lei n.º 10/X/2022 on access to and reuse of administrative documents, approved 8 April 2022, promulgated 9 May 2022 and published 16 May 2022, which gives everyone a right to consult, copy and be informed of administrative documents held by public bodies and takes effect 180 days after publication.
